description: A disposable review variant of the Private Health Log, preloaded with six months of deterministic fictional measurements in its own SQLite database. It uses the same services and facade as the normal demo so its charts, table and editing behavior can be reviewed after substantial use. This is generated test data, not medical data or medical guidance. A daily free-text journal is stored beside the measurements and appears in chart hover details.

state.schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS health_measurement (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_id <> ''),
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind <> ''),
  value       REAL NOT NULL CHECK(value > 0),
  unit        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(unit <> ''),
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(observed_at <> ''),
  created     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS health_measurement_event_kind
  ON health_measurement(event_id, kind);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS health_measurement_kind_time
  ON health_measurement(kind, observed_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS health_log_meta (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS health_journal (
  day        TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(day <> ''),
  entry      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entry <> ''),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
WITH RECURSIVE
  days(day) AS (
    SELECT 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT day + 1 FROM days WHERE day < 179
  ),
  glucose_slots(slot, hour) AS (
    VALUES (0, '08'), (1, '13')
  )
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO health_measurement (event_id, kind, value, unit, observed_at)
SELECT
  printf('review-glucose-%03d-%d', day, slot),
  'glucose',
  round(100 + ((day * 17 + slot * 29) % 55) + ((day % 5) * 0.4), 1),
  'mg/dL',
  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT' || hour || ':00:00Z', 'now', printf('-%d days', day))
FROM days CROSS JOIN glucose_slots
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM health_log_meta WHERE key = 'loaded-review-seeded-v1'
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  printf('review-bp-%03d', day),
  'blood-pressure-systolic',
  112 + ((day * 7) % 24),
  'mmHg',
  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT19:00:00Z', 'now', printf('-%d days', day))
FROM days
WHERE day % 2 = 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM health_log_meta WHERE key = 'loaded-review-seeded-v1'
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  printf('review-bp-%03d', day),
  'blood-pressure-diastolic',
  70 + ((day * 5) % 14),
  'mmHg',
  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT19:00:00Z', 'now', printf('-%d days', day))
FROM days
WHERE day % 2 = 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM health_log_meta WHERE key = 'loaded-review-seeded-v1'
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  printf('review-weight-%03d', day),
  'weight',
  round(77.4 + (day * 0.006) + ((((day * 11) % 9) - 4) * 0.05), 1),
  'kg',
  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT07:30:00Z', 'now', printf('-%d days', day))
FROM days
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM health_log_meta WHERE key = 'loaded-review-seeded-v1'
);
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO health_log_meta (key, value)
VALUES ('loaded-review-seeded-v1', '720 fictional rows across 180 days');
WITH RECURSIVE note_days(day) AS (
  SELECT 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT day + 3 FROM note_days WHERE day < 177
)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO health_journal (day, entry)
SELECT
  date('now', printf('-%d days', day)),
  CASE day % 15
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Poor sleep. Headache in the afternoon and less water than usual.'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Long walk after lunch. Felt energetic. No alcohol.'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Late pasta dinner and one glass of wine.'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'Busy workday. Skipped lunch and had a migraine in the evening.'
    ELSE 'Normal meals, plenty of water and light exercise.'
  END
FROM note_days
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM health_log_meta WHERE key = 'loaded-review-journal-seeded-v1'
);
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO health_log_meta (key, value)
VALUES ('loaded-review-journal-seeded-v1', '60 fictional journal entries');
state.statement:
INSERT INTO health_measurement (event_id, kind, value, unit, observed_at)
SELECT $eventId, $kind, CAST($value AS REAL), $unit, $observedAt
 WHERE $operation = 'add-value'

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN instr($value, '/') > 1
      THEN CAST(trim(substr($value, 1, instr($value, '/') - 1)) AS REAL) ELSE 0 END AS systolic,
    CASE WHEN instr($value, '/') > 1
      THEN CAST(trim(substr($value, instr($value, '/') + 1)) AS REAL) ELSE 0 END AS diastolic
)
INSERT INTO health_measurement (event_id, kind, value, unit, observed_at)
SELECT $eventId, 'blood-pressure-systolic', systolic, $unit, $observedAt
  FROM parsed
 WHERE $operation = 'add-blood-pressure'
UNION ALL
SELECT $eventId, 'blood-pressure-diastolic', diastolic, $unit, $observedAt
  FROM parsed
 WHERE $operation = 'add-blood-pressure'

INSERT INTO health_journal (day, entry, updated_at)
SELECT date($observedAt), trim($journal), datetime('now')
 WHERE $operation = 'save-journal'
   AND trim($journal) <> ''
ON CONFLICT(day) DO UPDATE SET
  entry = excluded.entry,
  updated_at = excluded.updated_at

DELETE FROM health_measurement
 WHERE $operation = 'delete'
   AND event_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($eventIds))

state.statement:
SELECT
  m.event_id AS eventId,
  CASE m.kind
    WHEN 'glucose' THEN 'Blood glucose'
    WHEN 'blood-pressure-systolic' THEN 'Systolic'
    WHEN 'blood-pressure-diastolic' THEN 'Diastolic'
    WHEN 'weight' THEN 'Weight'
    ELSE m.kind
  END AS measurement,
  CASE m.kind
    WHEN 'glucose' THEN 'Blood glucose'
    WHEN 'blood-pressure-systolic' THEN 'Systolic'
    WHEN 'blood-pressure-diastolic' THEN 'Diastolic'
    WHEN 'weight' THEN 'Weight'
    ELSE m.kind
  END AS series,
  round(m.value, 1) AS value,
  m.unit,
  m.observed_at AS observedAt,
  j.entry AS journal
FROM health_measurement AS m
LEFT JOIN health_journal AS j
  ON j.day = date(m.observed_at)
ORDER BY m.observed_at DESC, m.id DESC
